LanguageData.Gun_Galil_MAR_556mm_RWP.label: Galil MAR 5.56mm
LanguageData.Gun_Galil_MAR_556mm_RWP.description: The Galil MAR 5.56mm is a compact, carbine variant of the Galil rifle renowned for its reliability and high rate of fire. Ideal for rapid engagements and close-quarters combat, it delivers precise shots with moderate recoil and offers a balance between stopping power and maneuverability in the field. Perfect for colonists who need a versatile and trusty firearm at their side.
